features.name: avg_donation_volume
features.description: The average volume of blood donated per donation event (in c.c.).
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes total volume by frequency, providing a rate that may be more stable and discriminative than the raw volume.

features.name: donation_rate_per_month
features.description: The number of donations per month, averaged over the donor's entire history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the intensity of donation activity. A tree can easily find thresholds on this rate.

features.name: donation_consistency_months
features.description: The average number of months between donations. Lower values indicate more consistent donors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an alternative view of donation frequency that may capture different patterns.

features.name: is_very_recent_donor
features.description: Indicator that the last donation was within the last 3 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a simple, powerful binary split for the model based on a key recency threshold.

features.name: is_highly_frequent_donor
features.description: Indicator for donors with more than 10 total donations, identifying the most active group.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates a potentially distinct group of highly committed donors for the tree model to split on.

features.name: is_long_term_donor
features.description: Indicator for a donation history longer than 4 years (48 months).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a binary feature separating donors with a long history from newer ones.

features.name: donation_period_months
features.description: The total duration in months between the first and last donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the active lifespan of a donor, which can be a useful signal.

features.name: overdue_indicator
features.description: Indicator that the time since last donation is greater than the donor's historical average time between donations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a binary feature identifying donors who may have lapsed based on their own past behavior.

features.name: log_total_volume
features.description: Log-transformed total volume donated to reduce the effect of outliers and skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the range of the monetary feature, which can sometimes help tree models find better split points.

features.name: recency_frequency_product
features.description: An interaction term multiplying recency and frequency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly models the interaction between two important variables, which can save the tree model from having to learn it through multiple splits.

features.name: donor_profile_quadrant
features.description: Categorizes donors into four quadrants based on donation history length and frequency, using training set means as thresholds (V4 mean ~35, V2 mean ~5). 1: New/Infrequent, 2: Established/Frequent, 3: Established/Infrequent, 4: New/Frequent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single categorical feature that summarizes a donor's high-level profile, allowing the tree to create rules for these distinct segments.

features.name: donor_recency_status
features.description: Ordinal status based on months since last donation. 1: Active (<= 4 months), 2: Cooling Off (5-12 months), 3: Lapsed (> 12 months).
features.expected_model_benefit: Buckets the recency variable into interpretable, ordered groups that are easy for a tree model to split on.
